## Private mode (screened pool)

| | |
|---|---|
| Payer | one-time wallet `0xeF165282962C9A9eb3Bb953538791b8494c2Dfa3`, used for this assessment only |
| Cover | 4 complete assessments bought together, checks shuffled and spaced with random gaps |
| Total paid | $0.24 for all 4 (this memo's share $0.06) |
| Observer picking the real one | blind guess 0.25; best measured attacker not measured |
| Funding | the Tacitum screened pool `0xfd7aa64e839003a3b7c20080653f0202e97c5e1b` paid $1 into the payer's escrow through a zero-knowledge withdraw, tx `0xe90dbcda…dd06b9`. The desk's deposit is one of 16 approved deposits, each screened through Telegraph sanctions before it could be spent |

The feed shows 4 counterparties assessed by a new wallet, in no particular order: `FirstGroup PLC`, `Next PLC`, `BAE Systems PLC`, `Tesco PLC`. Nothing in the questions marks which one the desk wanted.

**Funding:** the payer was funded by the pool, not by the desk. Anyone can see which wallets deposited, but not which deposit paid for this assessment: it is one of 16 approved deposits, so that set size is the number to watch. On testnet the other depositors are seeded by us.

Decoy results stay in the local run record and are not part of this memo.

## Audit record

Sealed to auditor key `5dbf68a454022585` in `assessments/audit/2026-11-15-agent-tesco-plc.audit.json` (sha256 `a9f24c05c522fc87…`).

I ran one private assessment of Tesco PLC (GB, 4 parties). **The overall verdict is FLAG**, and the flag comes only from adverse news.

| Check | Verdict | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| Sanctions (two independent screeners) | **CLEAR** | No match on either. Lists checked: US OFAC SDN and non-SDN, UN, EU, UK and Canada. |
| Company registry | **CLEAR** | TESCO PLC, company no. 00445790, LEI 2138002P5RNKC5W2JZ46, active in both sources. |
| Regulatory filings | **INFO** | 55 filings in the last 12 months. This is for information only, not a concern. |
| Adverse news | **FLAG** | 21 adverse items from 21 sources, rated high risk. |

**Receipts:** all 6 paid checks were re-verified against the public record. The payer and settlement transaction matched for every one.

**Screened-pool funding: yes.** The checks were paid by a one-time wallet (`0xeF16…2Dfa3`), which received its $1 from the Tacitum screened pool through a zero-knowledge withdrawal (tx `0xe90d…dd06b9`). The fund's own wallet didn't pay. Anyone watching can see which wallets put money into the pool, but not which of the 16 approved deposits paid for this check.

**Cover:** Tesco was checked alongside three decoys: FirstGroup PLC, Next PLC and BAE Systems PLC. All 4 were bought together, shuffled and spaced out. The total cost was $0.24, of which $0.06 was Tesco's share.

Before you rely on this:
- **The adverse news flag needs a person to read the 21 items** before the agreement is signed. The memo gives only a count and a risk rating, not what the stories are about. For a company of Tesco's size, many items may be routine press, but I haven't confirmed that.
- **The privacy is weaker than it looks.** The tool says the other 15 pool deposits are seeded by Tacitum on testnet, so the real group of independent depositors hiding the fund is smaller than 16. It also hasn't measured how well an attacker could pick out the real company. The only figure given is a blind guess at 1 in 4.

A sealed audit record was saved to `assessments/audit/2026-11-15-agent-tesco-plc.audit.json`.
